commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
90+3' A precise low pass is received by Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well wide of the left post.
90+3' A cross from Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
90+2' The ball is cleared after Robert Navarro (Ath Bilbao) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
90+1' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

90+1' A sweet pass finds Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the bottom left corner. Alex Remiro is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. The ball is out of play. Ath Bilbao will have a chance to score from a corner.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
88' 1 - 1 Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Alex Remiro with a strike into the right side of the goal. He makes it 1:1.
87' A lofted cross from Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
86' An attempted cross from Robert Navarro (Ath Bilbao) is cleared.
85' The referee signals a substitution. Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad) is brought on as a substitute for Pablo Marin.
84' Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao) criticises the decision of the referee and immediately receives a yellow card.
83' Red card! Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) is given a red card for his behaviour.
82' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
80' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.

79' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
79' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao) comes onto the pitch so that Jesus Areso can be given a rest.
78' Izeta (Ath Bilbao) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
77' Pellegrino Matarazzo has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Wesley (Real Sociedad) replacing Goncalo Guedes.
77' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) will replace Mikel Oyarzabal.
75' Guillermo Cuadra shows a yellow card to Izeta (Ath Bilbao) for his blatant foul.
75' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
75' Foul! Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) is penalised for pulling back his opponent. Ath Bilbao are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
74' Robert Navarro (Ath Bilbao) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
72' Ernesto Valverde has decided to make a change. Izeta (Ath Bilbao) replaces Alex Berenguer.
72' It is time for a substitution. Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) is on for Nico Williams.
71' Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
69' Jesus Areso (Ath Bilbao) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Guillermo Cuadra ignores the protests.
69' Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
68' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
67' A pass from Jesus Areso (Ath Bilbao) is intercepted by Alex Remiro and the move breaks down.
65' Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad) makes a strong challenge and Guillermo Cuadra blows for a foul.
64' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
63' Here comes a substitution. Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) is brought on as a substitute for Luka Sucic.
63' Pellegrino Matarazzo prepares a substitution. Jon Gorrotxategi is replaced by Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad).
62' Today's match ends for Unai Gomez who will be replaced by Robert Navarro (Ath Bilbao).
62' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
61' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) serves up a nice cross, but Alex Remiro punches the ball away. Ath Bilbao earn a corner.
60' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) tries his luck with a shot from long distance after receiving a good pass. His poorly placed effort flies miles wide of the left post.
58' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.

58' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Guillermo Cuadra stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. A free kick has been awarded to Ath Bilbao.
56' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) was quite harsh and Guillermo Cuadra didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

55' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) missed a great opportunity! He finds himself some space near the penalty spot and plants a header goalwards which lacks both power and accuracy. The ball sails well over the bar!
55' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
55' Good work from Real Sociedad as they win a corner. Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
53' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
52' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) amazingly found his way through the defence, but lacked a precise finish as his effort from close range went slightly wide of the right post.
51' Jon Martin (Real Sociedad) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.
50' Jon Martin (Real Sociedad) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Guillermo Cuadra no option but to blow his whistle.
49' Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao) took a first-time shot from mid-range after he was put in the clear by a great pass, but the effort lacked a little accuracy and went just wide of the left post.
48' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
48' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

47' The referee points to the corner flag and Ath Bilbao will take a corner. Adama Boiro (Ath Bilbao) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
46' Ernesto Valverde has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) comes on the pitch for Alejandro Rego.
46' Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
45' The linesman signals that Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
42' Adama Boiro (Ath Bilbao) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
41' Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.

38' 0 - 1 Sergio Gomez passes to Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad), who collects the ball and unleashes a terrific shot from the edge of the box. His effort goes into the bottom left corner. Fabulous goal! The score is 0:1.
37' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) takes it short.

37' Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad) creates himself some space inside the goalmouth and connects with the resulting free kick. His accurate header would have probably ended up inside the left post, but Unai Simon pulls off a superb reflex save to thwart him. Real Sociedad will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
36' Referee Guillermo Cuadra sees the trip by Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
36' Jon Martin (Real Sociedad) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
32' Adama Boiro (Ath Bilbao) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
31' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
30' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
27' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
27' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
23' Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Guillermo Cuadra had an easy-decision to make.
22' Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad) gets on the end of a defence splitting pass inside the box and immediately directs a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Unai Simon makes a great save.
21' Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad) sends the corner into the box, but Unai Simon intercepts it and averts the threat.
20' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender. Real Sociedad have a corner.
20' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao). Guillermo Cuadra saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
19' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Alex Remiro, who smothers the ball.
17' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
16' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
15' Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. The ball goes out for a corner. Ath Bilbao can continue in their attacking effort.
15' It looks like Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) saw red with that tackle. Guillermo Cuadra won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
12' The game is interrupted now, Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
10' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

10' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Ath Bilbao. That's unlucky! Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
10' A pass by Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
8' Guillermo Cuadra has a clear sight and sees a foul from Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad).
6' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
6' Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out of play. Ath Bilbao are awarded a corner kick.

5' Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike to the bottom left corner. Unai Simon pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill.
4' Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad) picks up a long through ball, but Unai Simon deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
3' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
2' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) commits a rough challenge and Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle for an infringement.
1' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and Ath Bilbao will have the kick-off.
Guillermo Cuadra is introduced as the referee for today's match.
